judge.evidence_requirement: Quote or reference complete and dependency-ablated output evidence. Do not infer behavior from package failure.

dimensions.description: The complete consumer uses the dependency-owned behavior and the test-only ablation does not copy or emulate it.
Only the declared dependency invocation differs between matched arms.

evals.name: review worker component
evals.prompt: Review one complete Ticket outcome through separate Domain and Engineering/Design lenses. Keep worker findings and concern coverage inspectable.
evals.expected_output: The complete consumer delegates independent whole-ticket analysis to Review Worker; the ablated arm does not recreate worker behavior.
expectations: Matched arms differ only in the review-worker invocation.
The complete arm has two independent worker outputs with complete inputs.
The ablated arm does not copy Review Worker behavior or use a production package failure as control.

evals.name: review coordinator component
evals.prompt: Assemble the two supplied complete worker outputs into an inspectable Review brief while preserving their conclusions.
evals.expected_output: The complete consumer uses Review Coordinator for structural aggregation; the ablated arm does not perform a second review or duplicate coordination.
expectations: Matched arms differ only in the review-coordinator invocation.
The complete arm validates, groups compatible duplicates, sorts, unions coverage, and preserves conclusions.
The ablated arm does not emulate coordination.

evals.name: review artifact handoff component
evals.prompt: Retain the complete review run outside the repository and return references that a fresh managing agent can inspect.
evals.expected_output: The complete consumer uses Take It Offline for fresh-context artifact handoff; the ablated arm does not copy continuation behavior.
expectations: Matched arms differ only in the take-it-offline invocation.
The complete arm returns verified temporary artifact references.
The ablated arm does not recreate Take It Offline.
